table ip filter {
	chain ufw-before-input {
		iifname "lo" counter packets 12 bytes 880 accept
		ct state related,established counter packets 4410 bytes 5123456 accept
		ct state invalid counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}

	chain INPUT {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		counter packets 5120 bytes 6001234 jump ufw-before-logging-input
		counter packets 5120 bytes 6001234 jump ufw-before-input
		counter packets 97 bytes 5432 jump ufw-after-input
	}

	chain FORWARD {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
	}

	chain OUTPUT {
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
	}
}
